fields.name: Data
fields.explain: Carries one block of file data. A full-size block means more data follows, while a shorter block marks the end.

cite.quote: The data field is from zero to 512 bytes long.  If it is 512 bytes long, the block is not the last block of data; if it is from zero to 511 bytes long, it signals the end of the transfer.
